steps.js: const out=[]; const all=[...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e=>[...e.childNodes].some(n=>n.nodeType===3&&n.textContent.trim()==='用卡')); for(const e of all){ const box=e.closest('label,div'); const sel=(box&&box.querySelector('select'))||e.parentElement?.querySelector('select'); if(!sel) continue; const tn=[...e.childNodes].find(n=>n.nodeType===3&&n.textContent.trim()==='用卡'); const r=document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(tn); const tr=r.getBoundingClientRect(); const s=sel.getBoundingClientRect(); const hint=(box.querySelector('.v3e-lanehint')||box.parentElement?.querySelector('.v3e-lanehint'))?.getBoundingClientRect(); out.push({labelMid:+(tr.top+tr.height/2).toFixed(1), selectMid:+(s.top+s.height/2).toFixed(1), diff:+Math.abs((tr.top+tr.height/2)-(s.top+s.height/2)).toFixed(1), selectH:Math.round(s.height), labelLeft:Math.round(tr.left), hintLeft:hint?Math.round(hint.left):null}); } return out;

const out=[]; const all=[...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e=>[...e.childNodes].some(n=>n.nodeType===3&&n.textContent.trim()==='用卡')); for(const e of all){ const box=e.closest('label,div'); const sel=(box&&box.querySelector('select'))||e.parentElement?.querySelector('select'); if(!sel) continue; const tn=[...e.childNodes].find(n=>n.nodeType===3&&n.textContent.trim()==='用卡'); const r=document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(tn); const tr=r.getBoundingClientRect(); const s=sel.getBoundingClientRect(); const hint=(box.querySelector('.v3e-lanehint')||box.parentElement?.querySelector('.v3e-lanehint'))?.getBoundingClientRect(); out.push({labelMid:+(tr.top+tr.height/2).toFixed(1), selectMid:+(s.top+s.height/2).toFixed(1), diff:+Math.abs((tr.top+tr.height/2)-(s.top+s.height/2)).toFixed(1), selectH:Math.round(s.height), labelLeft:Math.round(tr.left), hintLeft:hint?Math.round(hint.left):null}); } return out;

const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sea-row')]; let bad=[]; for(const row of rows){ const cells=[...row.querySelectorAll(':scope > .sea-cell, .sea-cell')].filter(c=>c.parentElement===row); if(cells.length<2) continue; const tops=cells.map(c=>c.getBoundingClientRect().top), hs=cells.map(c=>c.getBoundingClientRect().height); const dt=Math.max(...tops)-Math.min(...tops), dh=Math.max(...hs)-Math.min(...hs); if(dt>0.5||dh>0.5) bad.push({dt:+dt.toFixed(1),dh:+dh.toFixed(1)}); } const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sea-link')].map(l=>Math.round(l.getBoundingClientRect().height)); return {rows:rows.length, misaligned:bad.length, sample:bad.slice(0,5), linkHeights:[...new Set(links)]};
